item.title: Lindblad Resonance
item.description:

item.description: There are two(three) phases of growth: orderly growth: mass growth, but mass spectrum keeps the same (fractal) runaway growth: (exponential), ceases at the point when the viscous stirring of the largest body exceeds the amount by the rest of planetesimals. origarchic growth: (a small number of objects grow quickly while others don't) This initial stage happens relatively quickly (0.01-1Myr). item.description:

In terms of Jupiter, the gravitational probes has detected NO significant solid core, and people theorize that Jupiter might had collisions with other planets and the core became diffuse afterwards.
